description: This file defines the BuzzFeedPostModel class which models a social media post (text, photo, video, or share) within the OrangeHRM system. It implements serialization via the Normalizable interface, transforming a BuzzFeedPost DTO into a structured array suitable for API responses. It includes detailed OpenAPI annotations describing the schema for various post types.

classes.name: BuzzFeedPostModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes a BuzzFeedPost DTO into an array representation conforming to OpenAPI schema definitions for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a BuzzFeedPost DTO.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the BuzzFeedPost DTO to an associative array suitable for API serialization, including optional video link and photo IDs.
